summary: First-run testing of Promethius MVP. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed (auth/JWT, models, Anthropic chat + persistence, conversations, memory, vault, projects+tasks, journal, search/video 503 graceful, admin RBAC). Frontend: 16/16 UI flows verified (login as admin, send chat with Anthropic default and receive real reply, sidebar listing & persistence, memory/vault/projects/journal tools add+display, studio panel, model selector lists all 3 providers, web-search toggle does not crash, admin dashboard loads stats + users table, logout). OpenAI-dependent paths (gpt-4o-mini, image/voice) correctly surface a clean 500 'AI error' / 'Execution failed' instead of crashing — as expected with the OOQ key.

minor.issue: Returns 200 + [] for non-existent or deleted conversation owned by another user instead of 404. Minor info leak / inconsistency with delete-conversation flow.
Accepts task status as a query-string param (?status=done) rather than JSON body — unusual REST design but functional.
Hard-coded to provider='openai', model='gpt-4o-mini'. User-supplied OpenAI key is OOQ so this always 500s. Consider falling back to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 for autonomous execution.

issues: lg:hidden block visible on mobile but the right-side BG image only shows on lg+ — acceptable.
Voice record button cannot be exercised in CI (no mic) — only toggles state; OK by design.

action_items: (Optional) Switch /api/tasks/{id}/execute default provider/model from 'openai/gpt-4o-mini' to 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6' so autonomous execution works out of the box on the user's working key.
(Optional) /api/conversations/{id}/messages should return 404 when the conversation doesn't belong to the user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 695 lines — within limit but starting to grow; consider splitting into routers per resource (auth, chat, memory, vault, projects, journal, admin).
All endpoints correctly use the /api prefix and exclude Mongo _id via projection.
JWT auth is consistent; HTTPBearer + get_current_user dependency used everywhere.

init_storage() is sync (requests) — fine at startup but blocks the event loop if called inside handlers (used in put_object/get_object which are themselves sync — acceptable but consider httpx async for high-throughput).
execute_task hard-codes provider 'openai'/'gpt-4o-mini' — should respect provider/model from request body or fall back to the default Anthropic model.
Front-end Admin.jsx silently swallows API errors with .catch(() => {}) — would mask 401/403 from the admin endpoints; consider showing a toast.
ChatPanel.jsx generateImage() builds an unused `url` variable from baseURL — minor dead code.
All interactive elements have data-testid as required.
test_credentials: admin@promethius.ai / Fire2026! (existing admin). Regular user auto-created per test run with email test_<hex>@example.com / TestPass!2026.
seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_-prefixed memory/note/project/task/journal entries per run; cleanup of project happens, other rows kept (volume tiny).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 11 feature areas in the request and passes under pytest-xdist (-n 2 --dist loadscope). Use admin@promethius.ai / Fire2026! for admin tests. OpenAI key is OOQ — treat any 500 from /chat (provider=openai), /image/generate, /voice/*, /tasks/*/execute as expected-graceful, not a bug. TAVILY/FAL keys empty — /search and /video/generate must return 503. Don't use a `.test` TLD for register payloads (Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs); use @example.com.
rca of the issue: Initial UI run reported admin-dashboard-loaded as failing — root cause was a race: the assertion ran before the two .then() callbacks (stats + users) resolved. Re-running with an extra 4s wait showed the dashboard renders correctly (Users=3, Conversations=5, Messages=6, table populated with 3 users). NOT a defect.
